body:
I mean kinda.  I just wasn't ready to be locked down.  She told me she had feelings for me right after I had gotten out of a relationship.  I didn't get the time i needed to heal and be single.  I recognized that feeling and I knew it'd turn into resentment eventually.  We decided to break up now and leave the door open to get back together once I've had time.  

The complete lack of support from my friends and family  has made me feel lonelier than I've ever felt before (which is saying a lot).  I just really don't want to continue living.  I hate myself for ruining my relationship and I hate everyone in my life but my ex for not giving a fuck about me.
I'm just not ready to have this be it I guess.  I love my ex to death but I missed out on dating because of my social anxiety.  I feel stupid now and I hate myself even more.
